issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the appellant mother (PA) not bisexual
issues.applicant_position: RPD failed to assess her sexuality properly and ignored corroborating pictures, affidavits and warrant.
issues.result_text: RPD erred; PA established bisexuality on balance of probabilities and a serious persecution risk.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD properly weighed the psychological report
issues.applicant_position: Report notes memory and concentration difficulties; RPD gave it no weight over one minor inconsistency.
issues.result_text: RPD erred in rejecting bisexuality for lack of an ex-partner's surname without considering the report's content.

issues.issue: Whether the minor male appellant faces persecution because of his mother's bisexuality
issues.applicant_position: He fears persecution in Nigeria by his father's family due to his mother's sexuality.
issues.result_text: Minor male appellant's claim is allowed; he has a nexus and serious possibility of persecution.

issues.issue: Whether the minor female appellant (a US citizen) faces risk in Nigeria
issues.applicant_position: Fears FGM and cleansing ritual for daughter; the affidavits support the allegations.
issues.result_text: No evidence of risk if she returns to the US; she is not a Convention refugee or person in need of protection.
